narrative_purpose: Grounds the whole argument in an Earth case the reader can verify: the American chestnut forest that existed a century ago and the stump-sprout remnant that replaced it. Shows what functional extinction actually looks like - the species alive as tissue, gone as a participant.
subject: A two-panel comparison study. Left panel: a tall broadleaf forest interior dominated by enormous straight-trunked chestnut trees, their crowns closing overhead, heavy nut husks scattered on the open floor, a few birds and a deer in the middle distance, the trunks wide enough that several would fill an arm span. Right panel: the same forest a century later, now oaks and maples of ordinary size, and in the foreground a broad dead chestnut stump ringed with thin juvenile shoots, none taller than a person, one shoot already blighted and browning.
scene: Temperate Appalachian broadleaf forest interior in both panels, same viewpoint, same slope of ground, so the eye reads it as one place across time.
camera: A fixed eye-level view into the forest interior, repeated identically in both panels, matched ground line.
light: Left panel: high dappled light falling through a closed giant canopy in long soft shafts. Right panel: flatter, more even light from a lower, less structured canopy - visibly less depth and less shadow.
palette: Cool teal-green and bone-grey in the left panel with restrained amber in the light shafts, duller grey-green and dry brown in the right panel, void-indigo in the deep shadows of both.
style: Painterly naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, documentary and unsentimental.
detail_level: Crisp on the chestnut trunk bark and nut husks on the left; crisp on the dead stump, its thin shoots and the blighted leaves on the right; middle distance softer in both.
composition: Two equal vertical panels side by side with a narrow dark gutter, matched ground line across both, the great trunks anchoring the left and the low stump anchoring the lower right, 16:9 landscape.
consistency_notes: This is an Earth plate, not a Pandoran one - no bioluminescence and no alien flora. Keep the palette cool and restrained so it still sits beside the chapter's other figures.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no bioluminescent glow, no alien plants, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon or anime style
